description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target Dark/NE magic attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Lv.3 En-Dark, En-Dark Stack, Cap Break Level 1, Zenith Army Gear & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Dark Damage +20%, Magic Casting Speed x1.1 & chases a Dark ability with Sorcery Damage +30% for 3 turns to party (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Dark, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Sacrifice Pawn+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses; Ruthless Gear+: 1.65s CT, Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses 
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
Zenith Army Gear: [Dark Damage +20% to user] or [MAG/MND/DEF/RES +15% for 8 seconds to party] with at least 0/4 Mage II members in party
